eligibility_criteria: 1. Completed the age of 21 years on or before 31st December of the year of admission to the program.2. Undergraduate degree from a recognized University with minimum 50% marks or CGPA of 5.0.3. In case of students from foreign Universities, they should have qualifications recognized as equivalent to an Undergraduate degree.4. Academic qualification: B.Sc. degree course in Zoology as the main subject with Botany as ancillary subject and B.Sc. Botany/ B.Sc. degree in Life Sciences, Bio-Science or Biology/ Professional course such as B.S.M.S., B.U.M.S., B.A.M.S., B.H.M.S., BDS., BPT., BOT., MPT & MOT/ B.Sc in Anatomy
